eval: (() => { if (!document.title.includes('Panorama') || window.__game.state !== 'title') throw new Error('Title did not load'); return document.title; })()

(() => { const g = window.__game; if (g.state !== 'race' || g.race.player.vehicle.speed < 1) throw new Error('Race did not drive'); return { state: g.state, speed: g.race.player.vehicle.speed, quality: g.settings.quality }; })()
